answer: An copycat hence cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. The gale schedule is applied in summit and zephyr makes public each instalment. A payout is split so that 35% arrives at settlement and the rest over 18 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. A farm of 3247 identities would post 4472 proofs and burn roughly 52 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
